genre_archetype: feed recipe animal ranch with quality-based production orders
camera_perspective: three-quarter top-down ranch board with stable animal silhouettes and readable pen zones
control_model: tap animals and buildings, drag feed recipes to pens, tap order cards, use short hold for batch collection
core_loop_signature: grow or restock ingredients, mix named feed snacks, feed realistic animal types, collect quality products, fulfill recipe-matched orders, unlock new animals, pens, and feed stations
differentiation_axes: feed recipe selection is the primary decision instead of generic feed and clean meters
animal product quality depends on recipe fit, freshness, mood, and timing
orders request product quality combinations, not only raw item counts
visual requirement favors realistic animal silhouettes over simple mascot circles
UI uses cookbook and order clipboard panels instead of repeated top pills plus bottom command strip
forbidden_template_reuse: do not copy Pasture Parade Deluxe multi-species pen adjacency combo loop
do not copy Market Morning Farm crop stall pricing and customer queue loop
do not reduce animals to generic circles or rectangles
do not use a tiny single-screen pasture with one repeated pen type
do not use the same top HUD pill layout and bottom action strip as prior farm projects

map_content_budget.play_area_model: single ranch yard divided into functional production zones with upgradeable pen footprints
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: fixed landscape viewport with slight board pan only if content exceeds safe area

primary_player_actions: drag feed snacks to animal pens
tap mixer to craft feed recipes
tap order cards to fulfill deliveries
special_rules: each animal has favorite and disliked snack categories
fresh products lose quality if not moved to cooler
mixed snack recipes can create bonus output when matched correctly
premium orders require two product qualities in one delivery
risk_reward_systems: wait longer for higher quality but risk freshness decay
use rare ingredients for stronger output or save them for festival orders
reroll low-value orders at the cost of reputation
failure_pressure_variants: day timer ends before target reputation
animal mood falls if fed disliked snacks

primary_game_art_packs: license-clear semi-realistic farm animal sprites or generated repository art with quadruped and bird silhouettes
asset_variety_budget.ui_pack: cartoon ranch cookbook and clipboard UI assets built on skin_cartoon_light
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: delivery-ready animal idle, walk, eat, happy, and product-ready poses
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: animal bodies must read as cow, hen, sheep, goat, pig, and rabbit through real-world proportions, not only color swaps or icon labels
